BuoyancyAirflow.description:
Convection: air rising up the middle and sinking along the side walls,
over air warming with height and towards the middle.
BuoyancyAirflow.title: BuoyancyAirflow

CanopySample.description:
A sample taken of each scope of a crop grown by area, a measurement
model (decision 0062): every `every_days` days from the run's first, at
the walk's moment, each quantity read with a relative error, in percent,
of a normal spread `noise_pct` about the bias `bias_pct`. Its defaults
are an exploratory choice, not a source's. Noise and bias at zero make
it a perfect instrument, for research, which a manifest has to ask for.
It takes nothing from the canopy, as the air takes nothing from it, and
its readings are delivered as they are taken.
CanopySample.title: CanopySample

CfdSetup.description: What drives a scenario's air in a CFD solve, and for how long.
CfdSetup.title: CfdSetup

CirculationLoop.description:
Run the fans `fans` while the vents stand open at stage `from_stage`,
counted from 1, or beyond.
CirculationLoop.title: CirculationLoop

ConstantWeather.description:
One weather for the whole of a run, by default a calm 10 °C at 80%,
its pressure the standard atmosphere's at its site's elevation unless
given.
ConstantWeather.title: ConstantWeather

Control.description:
A greenhouse's climate controller: its loops, a day from
`day_from_s` and a night from `night_from_s`, times of a run's day on
the minute that every loop's targets share, and the dead band
`dead_band_c` that keeps heating and venting apart: in each period, the
vents' first stage closes above the temperature the heater switches off
at by at least that much.
Control.title: Control

Cover.description:
What the cover is made of: the roof's slopes, all of one material,
and each wall it names, of its own; the walls it does not name are of
the roof's.
Cover.title: Cover

CoverMaterial.description:
A sheet a cover is made of, given by its properties: what of the
sun's beam, falling square to it, and of the sky's diffuse light it
passes, what of the shortwave it reflects, what of the longwave it
emits and passes, and the heat it conducts and holds.

shortwave_beam_transmittance.description: the share of the sun's beam, falling square to it, that it passes

range_from.most: a share: all of what falls on it at most

shortwave_beam_transmittance.title: Shortwave Beam Transmittance

shortwave_diffuse_transmittance.description: the share of the sky's diffuse light falling on it that it passes

range_from.most: a share: all of what falls on it at most

shortwave_diffuse_transmittance.title: Shortwave Diffuse Transmittance

shortwave_reflectance.description: the share of the shortwave falling on it that it reflects

range_from.most: a share: all of what falls on it at most

shortwave_reflectance.title: Shortwave Reflectance

longwave_emissivity.description: its longwave emissivity: the share of the longwave falling on it that it absorbs

range_from.most: a share: all of what falls on it at most

longwave_emissivity.title: Longwave Emissivity

longwave_transmittance.description: the share of the longwave falling on it that it passes

range_from.most: a share: all of what falls on it at most

longwave_transmittance.title: Longwave Transmittance

range_from.least: none in its source: the field's type's
range_from.most: none in its source: the field's type's

range_from.least: none in its source: the field's type's
range_from.most: none in its source: the field's type's

range_from.least: none in its source: the field's type's

volumetric_heat_capacity_j_m3_k.title: Volumetric Heat Capacity J M3 K

CoverMaterial.title: CoverMaterial

CoverMaterialName.description: A cover's sheet the catalogue names.
CoverMaterialName.title: CoverMaterialName

CropModel.description:
How a scenario's run grows its crop: plant by plant, by the simple
daily model (`greenhouse_sim.core.simple_crop`) or organ by organ
(`greenhouse_sim.core.crop`); or by area, by Reduced-State TOMGRO
(`greenhouse_sim.core.tomgro_crop`) or Vanthoor's model as Katzin
simplified it (`greenhouse_sim.core.vanthoor_crop`, decision 0060).
CropModel.title: CropModel

CropWalk.description:
The daily walk through the crop's measurement errors, on either
crop's walk (`greenhouse_sim.services.crop_log`): the chance that a
count is one off, and the standard deviations of the ripe fruits'
estimated mass, in percent, and of a plant's measured height, in cm.
CropWalk.title: CropWalk

CropWork.title: CropWork

DailyCommand.description:
Set one piece of equipment to a level at a time of day, every day of
a run.
DailyCommand.title: DailyCommand

DehumidifyingLoop.description:
Dry the house's air to `target_pct` relative humidity: the
dehumidifier `actuator_id` on above the target by half `band_pct`, off
below it by as much. With `vents_when_drier`, the vents' first stage
opens too, while this loop is on, the heater off, and the air outside is
drier than the house's: its humidity ratio lower by `drier_by_g_kg`,
until it is lower by less than that less `drier_band_g_kg`.
DehumidifyingLoop.title: DehumidifyingLoop

Envelope.description: A greenhouse's envelope, in metres, no larger than any greenhouse.
Envelope.title: Envelope

Floor.description:
The floor, from its surface down: the surface's optics, its layers,
the first the floor's own and those under it the soil's, and the deep
soil's temperature under the last, in °C.
Floor.title: Floor

FloorLayer.description:
A layer of the floor, or of the soil under it: its thickness, in
metres, and what it is made of.
FloorLayer.title: FloorLayer

FloorSurface.description:
The floor's surface, given by its properties: what of the shortwave
it reflects, and its longwave emissivity.

shortwave_reflectance.description: the share of the shortwave falling on it that it reflects

range_from.most: a share: all of what falls on it at most

shortwave_reflectance.title: Shortwave Reflectance

longwave_emissivity.description: its longwave emissivity: the share of the longwave falling on it that it absorbs

range_from.most: a share: all of what falls on it at most

longwave_emissivity.title: Longwave Emissivity

FloorSurface.title: FloorSurface

GradientAirflow.description:
Still air whose temperature rises linearly along the house: a known
field to check sensors against.
GradientAirflow.title: GradientAirflow

GridAir.description:
The house's air cell by cell, on the field's grid, beside the whole
house's (`greenhouse_sim.climate.day`): the house air's model that draws
where its air is warm, damp or still, its parameters a climate run's.

infiltration_per_h_per_m_s.title: Infiltration Per H Per M S

GridAir.title: GridAir

HeatingLoop.description:
Heat the house's air with the heater `actuator_id` to `day_c` by day
and `night_c` by night: on below the setpoint by half `band_c`, off above
it by as much (decision 0042's thermostat).
HeatingLoop.title: HeatingLoop

HouseComponents.description:
What a house is made of and has beyond its envelope and layout, each
left out while undescribed: its cover's materials; what each wall it
names faces, the others facing the outside; its floor; the screens
drawn across it; and its networks of heating pipes. It describes one at
least: a house that describes none has no section of them. Its screens
and pipe networks are each named apart, as a command names one.
HouseComponents.title: HouseComponents

Installation.description:
A greenhouse as authored: no weather, period, control or policy,
which are a scenario's.

installation_id.description: Letters, digits, '_', '.' and '-' only: the API's parameters write it between ':' and ','.
installation_id.title: Installation Id

layout.description: The name of one of the scenario's layout files.

Installation.title: Installation

LayerMaterial.description:
What a layer of the floor, or of the soil under it, is made of, given
by its properties: the heat it conducts and holds.

range_from.least: none in its source: the field's type's
range_from.most: none in its source: the field's type's

volumetric_heat_capacity_j_m3_k.description: its heat capacity per volume: its density times its specific heat

range_from.least: none in its source: the field's type's
range_from.most: water's, 1000 kg m⁻³ times 4180 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹ (Vanthoor 2011, Table 8.1)

volumetric_heat_capacity_j_m3_k.title: Volumetric Heat Capacity J M3 K

LayerMaterial.title: LayerMaterial

LayerMaterialName.description: A floor's or the soil's layer the catalogue names.
LayerMaterialName.title: LayerMaterialName

NoParameters.description: The parameters of a model that takes none.
NoParameters.title: NoParameters

OnASpace.description:
A wall on a neighbouring space, a corridor, a headhouse or another
house, at its temperature: constant, in °C, or recorded in a file of
its own, which names it; one of the two.
OnASpace.title: OnASpace

OnTheOutside.description: A wall on the outside air, as a wall is unless it says otherwise.
OnTheOutside.title: OnTheOutside

Opening.description:
A door or vent: a rectangle on its host surface, centred at `centre` in
the host's own x-y plane, `width` along the host's x and `height` along
its y, open by `opening`, from 0 (closed) to 1.

opening_id.description: Letters, digits, '_', '.' and '-' only: the API's parameters write it between ':' and ','.
opening_id.title: Opening Id

Opening.title: Opening

OrganCrop.description:
The organ crop's settings (`greenhouse_sim.biology.tomato.organ`):
none a scenario chooses yet, its variety's being its own (P20).
OrganCrop.title: OrganCrop

PipeKind.description: Where a network of heating pipes runs.
PipeKind.title: PipeKind

PipeNetwork.description:
A network of heating pipes: where it runs, all its pipes' length end
to end, their outer and inner diameters, their height above the floor,
the eaves at most, and their longwave emissivity. Its heat leaves them
by convection to the air and by radiation to what they see, as the
model that heats them works out (P24.8).

network_id.description: Letters, digits, '_', '.' and '-' only: the API's parameters write it between ':' and ','.
network_id.title: Network Id

PipeNetwork.title: PipeNetwork

Point2.description: A point in a shape's own x-y plane.
Point2.title: Point2

Quaternion.description: A rotation as a unit quaternion; the default is no rotation.
Quaternion.title: Quaternion

RecordedWeather.description:
Weather recorded in a file of the recorded weather's directory, by its
name.
RecordedWeather.title: RecordedWeather

ReducedTomgroCrop.description:
Reduced-State TOMGRO's settings, grown by area
(`greenhouse_sim.biology.tomato.tomgro`, decisions 0060 and 0062): the
parameter set it runs, gnvman unless it names another, the driver
profile, named and versioned, through which the run gives it its drivers
(`greenhouse_sim.core.drivers`), and the height above its planting
positions at which the light above its canopy is read, which the model
does not grow: the run's choice, in m, not the model's.
ReducedTomgroCrop.title: ReducedTomgroCrop

RowCrop.description:
The crop one row grows: its model and its variety. Rows are numbered
from 1, as `CropRows` numbers them.
RowCrop.title: RowCrop

Screen.description:
A screen drawn across the house: what it is for, its cloth, the
height it is drawn at above the floor, the eaves at most, the floor it
covers, the whole house's if it names none, and how far it is drawn as
the run starts, from 0 (open) to 1 (closed). Commands and a screen
loop are to drive it, as they drive a vent (P24.4).

screen_id.description: Letters, digits, '_', '.' and '-' only: the API's parameters write it between ':' and ','.
screen_id.title: Screen Id

Screen.title: Screen

ScreenCloth.description:
A cloth a screen is made of, given by its properties: what of the
shortwave it passes and reflects, what of the longwave it emits and
passes, the air it lets through when it is drawn, and the heat it holds.
The air it lets through is Vanthoor's (2011) screen flux coefficient, K
in f = K |ΔT|^(2/3): the air through each square metre of it, in m³ a
second, for the difference of temperature across it.

shortwave_transmittance.description: the share of the shortwave falling on it that it passes

range_from.most: a share: all of what falls on it at most

shortwave_transmittance.title: Shortwave Transmittance

ScreenClothName.description: A screen's cloth the catalogue names.
ScreenClothName.title: ScreenClothName

ScreenKind.description: What a screen drawn across the house is for.
ScreenKind.title: ScreenKind

SeasonalWeather.description:
Weather through a season: each day's usual coldest and warmest
temperatures on the year's coldest day and half a year later, which day
of the year is coldest, how far a day's temperatures wander from their
usual ones and how much of that a day keeps from the day before, and
each day's clouds; and a synthetic day's shape, humidity and wind.
SeasonalWeather.title: SeasonalWeather

water_use_ml_per_day_base.title: Water Use Ml Per Day Base

stem_growth_cm_per_day_base.title: Stem Growth Cm Per Day Base

Site.description:
Where the world lies: its latitude and longitude (degrees north and
east), its elevation (metres above sea level), its time zone (by its
IANA name, such as `Europe/Amsterdam`), and the bearing of its x axis.
Site.title: Site

Strip.description:
A rectangle of the floor: a centre line from `start` to `end`, `width`
wide.
Strip.title: Strip

SyntheticWeather.description:
A day of weather, each day alike: its coldest and warmest temperatures
and their hours, its humidity at the coldest, its CO2, its calmest and
windiest winds, the direction the wind blows from at midnight and how
far it veers clockwise by the next (backing if negative), its gusts' size
as a share of the wind's speed, its cloud cover and its pressure.
SyntheticWeather.title: SyntheticWeather

Transform.description: Places a shape's own frame in the world: rotate, then translate.
Transform.title: Transform

UniformAirflow.description: One breeze everywhere, at one temperature.
UniformAirflow.title: UniformAirflow

VanthoorKatzinCrop.description:
The settings of Vanthoor's model as Katzin simplified it, grown by
area (`greenhouse_sim.biology.tomato.vanthoor`, decisions 0060 and
0062): the parameter set it runs, GreenLight 2.0.7's unless it names
another, the driver profile, named and versioned, through which the run
gives it its drivers (`greenhouse_sim.core.drivers`), and the height
above its planting positions at which the light above its canopy is
read, which the model does not grow: the run's choice, in m, not the
model's.
VanthoorKatzinCrop.title: VanthoorKatzinCrop

VentStage.description:
A stage of the vents: open to `level` once the air passes the venting
setpoint by `above_c`.
VentStage.title: VentStage

VentingLoop.description:
Vent the house's air through the vents `vents`, to `day_c` by day and
`night_c` by night, in `stages`: each opens when the air passes the
setpoint plus its `above_c`, and closes when the air falls back below
that by `band_c`.
VentingLoop.title: VentingLoop

VortexAirflow.description: One roll across the house, turning about its length.
VortexAirflow.title: VortexAirflow

WholeHouseAir.description:
The whole house's air alone, one well-mixed volume, which the run
draws the same in every cell (`greenhouse_sim.climate.day`): the house
air's model that works out no air cell by cell, so none of a grid's
mixing.

infiltration_per_h_per_m_s.title: Infiltration Per H Per M S

WholeHouseAir.title: WholeHouseAir

description:
The simulated world: its greenhouse, crop, dynamics and sensor noise.

Which management policy runs against it, and with what thresholds, is
not part of the world. That is the caller's choice about a run.

weather.description: The weather's model: 'constant' if none is named.

air_field.description: The air field's model: 'uniform' if none is named.

crop.description: The crop's model: the one its rows grow.

crop_walk.description: The crop walk's model: 'walk' if none is named.

sunlight.description: The sunlight's model: 'haurwitz_erbs' if none is named.

sensors.description: The sensors's model: 'sampled' if none is named.

house_air.description: The house air's model: 'grid' if none is named.

controller.description: The controller's model: 'none' if none is named.

models.description: The model each part of a run runs, by part, and its parameters.

opening_day.description: The day of its run where the viewer opens it, kept as a checkpoint.

notes.description: What the scenario, or one of its fields, is and why.
